ibus.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-dconf-Use-dbus-run-session-to-set-up-dconf-overrides.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-Stateless-dconf.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-use-bash-for-dconf-script.patch

# Can we disable xim now that we have appindicator? Needs more investigation
%reconfigure \
    --disable-gtk2 \
    --disable-static \
    --enable-vala \
    --enable-wayland \
    --with-python=python3 \
    CC_FOR_BUILD=${CC}
ibus.install:
%make_install

# Pre-compile the dconf db
pushd data/dconf
mkdir temp
make 00-upstream-settings
mv 00-upstream-settings temp
dconf compile ibus-dconf-defaults temp
install -Dm00644 ibus-dconf-defaults %(installroot)%(datadir)/ibus
popd

%install_file %(pkgdir)/trigger.yaml %(installroot)/usr/share/moss/triggers/sys.d/ibus_components.yaml

# Stateless paths
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/xdg/Xwayland-session.d/
mv %(installroot)/etc/xdg/Xwayland-session.d/* %(installroot)%(datadir)/xdg/Xwayland-session.d/
rmdir -v %(installroot)/etc/xdg/Xwayland-session.d \
         %(installroot)/etc/xdg/ \
         %(installroot)/etc/

icu.setup:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat/source

    # thunderbird to show Calendar and sidebar properly.
    # https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1843007
    # https://unicode-org.atlassian.net/browse/ICU-22132
    %patch %(pkgdir)/ICU-22132.patch -p2

    %configure
    popd
fi

cd source

# thunderbird to show Calendar and sidebar properly.
# https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1843007
# https://unicode-org.atlassian.net/browse/ICU-22132
%patch %(pkgdir)/ICU-22132.patch -p2

# Static libs for static bsdtar
%configure \
    --enable-static
icu.build:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat/source
        %ccache_zero
        env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}" %make
        %ccache_stats
    popd
fi

cd source
%ccache_zero
env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}" %make
%ccache_stats
icu.install:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat/source
        mkdir tmp
        make install DESTDIR="${PWD}/tmp"

        # Only copy the sonames
        %install_dir %(installroot)/%(libdir)
        find ${PWD}/tmp/%(libdir) -name "*.so.*" -print -exec mv {} %(installroot)/%(libdir) \;
    popd
fi

cd source
%make_install

intel-compute-runtime.setup:
# cmake strips -O and fortify flags from tests but fails
# since the regex is quite brittle. patch to match our flags
%patch %(pkgdir)/fortify-source-3.patch

# TODO: remove this patch in next update
%patch %(pkgdir)/ftbfs-llvm-23-unused-but-set-global.patch

%cmake \
    -DAUB_STREAM_DIR=%(buildroot)/aubstream.git \
    -DDISABLE_WDDM_LINUX=ON \
    -DLIBTRACEFS_INCLUDE_DIR=%(includedir)/libtracefs \
    -DNEO_BUILD_UNVERSIONED_OCLOC=ON \
    -DNEO_VERSION_BUILD=$(echo "%(version)" | cut -d. -f3) \
    -DOCL_ICD_VENDORDIR=%(datadir)/OpenCL/vendors

intel-graphics-compiler.setup:
# Fake-out opencl-clang into thinking its a git repo
# so that it can apply patches to itself (From Nix)
pushd ../
git -C llvm-project init
git -C llvm-project -c user.name=boulder -c user.email= commit --allow-empty -m stub
%patch %(pkgdir)/use-apply-instead-of-am.patch
popd

%cmake \
    -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 \
    -DIGC_OPTION__ARCHITECTURE_TARGET=Linux64 \
    -DIGC_OPTION__CLANG_MODE=Source \
    -DIGC_OPTION__LLD_MODE=Source \
    -DIGC_OPTION__LLVM_PREFERRED_VERSION="22.1.8" \
    -DIGC_OPTION__LLVM_MODE=Source \
    -DIGC_OPTION__LINK_KHRONOS_SPIRV_TRANSLATOR=ON \
    -DIGC_OPTION__SPIRV_TOOLS_MODE=Prebuilds \
    -DIGC_OPTION__USE_PREINSTALLED_SPIRV_HEADERS=ON \
    -DIGC_OPTION__VC_INTRINSICS_MODE=Source \
    -DLLVM_EXTERNAL_SPIRV_HEADERS_SOURCE_DIR=%(includedir)/spirv/ \
    -Wno-dev
intel-graphics-compiler.install:
%cmake_install

# Move and Remove stuff that conflict
mv %(installroot)%(includedir)/opencl-c{,-base}.h %(installroot)%(includedir)/igc
rm -f %(installroot)%(bindir)/lld

intel-microcode.install:
%install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/firmware/intel-ucode
%install_file intel-ucode-with-caveats/* %(installroot)%(libdir)/firmware/intel-ucode/.
%install_file intel-ucode/* %(installroot)%(libdir)/firmware/intel-ucode/.

# Construct early microcode initrd
%install_dir initrd/kernel/x86/microcode/
pushd initrd

touch kernel/x86/microcode/GenuineIntel.bin
for i in %(installroot)%(libdir)/firmware/intel-ucode/*; do
    cat ${i} >> kernel/x86/microcode/GenuineIntel.bin
done

find . -exec touch -d @0 {} \;
find . | cpio -o -H newc --device-independent --reproducible > ../intel-microcode.initrd
popd
%install_file intel-microcode.initrd %(installroot)%(libdir)/kernel/initrd.d/00-intel-microcode.initrd

for file in license releasenote.md README.md; do
    %install_file $file %(installroot)%(docdir)/intel-microcode/$file
done

iptables.install:

    rm -v %(installroot)/%(sbindir)/$i
    ln -s xtables-nft-multi %(installroot)/%(sbindir)/$i
done
